businesses.business: corporate digital learning and talent development

offering_description.value: Provides a cloud-based digital learning platform with courses, videos, books, audiobooks and coaching content for corporate employee training. Sells mainly to enterprises and government organizations through subscriptions. Content is produced in-house and licensed from partners, and delivered via its Percipio platform.

primary_products.value: digital learning subscriptions; online course content library; talent development software platform; compliance training content; leadership and technology skills courses

primary_services.value: AI-based coaching; skills assessment and certification prep; virtual instructor-led training; learning content customization

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises and businesses of all sizes buying employee training and compliance content; B2G: government agencies and public sector organizations

end_markets.value: corporate training; financial services; technology; healthcare; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring annual access to digital learning content and platform; service fees: instructor-led training, coaching and professional services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosts learning platform and licensed and self-produced content, sold to employers; service provider: delivers coaching and live training to corporate learners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: digital learning content, learning platform, coaching and global knowledge training services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to corporate and government accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers of learning content; online: self-service purchases through website

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, data privacy laws such as GDPR apply to learner data
